name: Brightmoor Gangster Crips
description: BGC (Brightmoor Gangster Crips) is a small Gangster Crip–aligned street group based in Detroit's Brightmoor area and the broader 48223 ZIP code known locally as the '23 Zone.' The group became locally known for graffiti activity and tag wars during the 2010s, while maintaining ties to nearby Gangster Disciples–aligned crews such as BMG. Some members adopt Grape Street Watts Crips (GSWC) symbolism and imagery, though the group denies formal ties to the original Watts-based set. In recent years, BGC has been associated with younger west side Detroit factions connected to the W7M ScoreGang Crips.

sources.title: The History and Impact of Crip-Affiliated Groups in Detroit
